requestKey: What is the best envelope budgeting app?|pocketpal.me|sample0

payload.text:
Short answer: there isn’t one “best” for everyone. Pick the envelope app that fits how you like to budget and sync.

Top picks by need
- Best overall envelope/zero-based experience: YNAB. It’s a polished, true envelope-style system with clear goals/targets and rollovers. ([ynab.com](https://www.ynab.com/the-four-rules/?utm_source=openai))
- Best simple and low-cost, with optional bank sync: Goodbudget. It’s built around digital envelopes; the free tier works manually, and Premium adds automatic bank syncing via Plaid. ([goodbudget.com](https://goodbudget.com/signup?source=supermoney-reviews-reviews&utm_source=openai))
- Best “real cash envelopes” feel at the point of purchase: Qube Money. It pairs envelopes with an app-linked debit card so you spend from a specific “Qube” you open before each purchase. ([qubemoney.com](https://qubemoney.com/?utm_source=openai))
- Best privacy/open-source vibe: Actual Budget. Local-first, envelope-style budgeting with optional bank sync via connectors. ([actualbudget.org](https://actualbudget.org/?utm_source=openai))
- Best spreadsheet-based envelope/rollover setup: Tiller. Use its community “Savings Budget” or “Envelope Budget” templates for rollover/envelope-style budgeting. ([tiller.com](https://tiller.com/community-templates/savings-budget-spreadsheet/?utm_source=openai))
- Best if you follow Dave Ramsey’s approach: EveryDollar. Zero-based budgeting with a straightforward workflow; Premium adds bank import. ([store.ramseysolutions.com](https://store.ramseysolutions.com/money/tools-and-apps/everydollar-budget-app/?yoReviewsPage=4&yoReviewsPage=7&utm_source=openai))

Good to know
- Mvelopes, a long-time envelope app, has been discontinued, so it’s no longer an option. ([financebuzz.com](https://financebuzz.com/mvelopes-review?utm_source=openai))
- If you’re open to using a bank with built-in “envelopes,” Ally’s Savings “Buckets” feature lets you earmark funds inside your account. ([ally.com](https://www.ally.com/stories/save/what-are-ally-banks-savings-buckets-and-boosters/?utm_source=openai))

Want a fast recommendation? Tell me:
1) Do you want automatic bank syncing or prefer manual entry?
2) Solo or shared budgeting with a partner/household?
3) Do you want debit-card controls that enforce envelopes at checkout?
